definitions.hit_token_fraction: Policy-valid positions with any clipped component / valid positions; not vocab fraction
definitions.pooled_vocabulary_fraction: Clipped vocabulary components / sum vocabulary size over valid positions
definitions.mass: Each independent distribution probability on same student reverse-component>10 set; exposure sums are not one probability
definitions.means: Separate pooled token, hit-token-only and equal-trajectory means; masses are never multiplied by W weights
definitions.nonmixture: mixture field is teacher target alias for groups other than M/J
definitions.loss: Native raw/post logged metrics; weighted objective separate, not gradient contribution

limitations: Recorded committed forward logs only; no logits/top32/fullNPY/model/tensor/EM/causal reconstruction. Recorded retries are not all failed attempts.
